title: Federal Student Loan Forgiveness
body:
Need something else? [Telemarketing Fraud](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/article/?kanumber=KA-01641) to report student loan scams In some situations, you can have your federal student loans forgiven. This means you don’t have to pay some or all of your loans. You can learn about federal forgiveness and repayment programs run by the U.S. Department of Education. Important: The federal student loan repayment pause ended on August 30, 2023 because of legislation passed by Congress. Interest resumed on September 1, 2023, and payments restarted on October 1, 2023. If you need help managing student loan debt, you can get free financial counseling at an NYC Financial Empowerment Center. Visit the [Financial Counseling](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/article/?kanumber=KA-02001) page to schedule an appointment.
Federal Parent PLUS Loans
Federal Parent PLUS loans are borrowed to finance a dependent's education.  Important: Federal Parent PLUS loan borrowers must take action ASAP to lock in loan benefits such as access to generous income-driven repayment (IDR) plans and the Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) program. Consolidation applications take at least 8 weeks to process and must be fully completed by  July 1, 2026 . [Learn more about Federal Parent PLUS loans.](https://www.nyc.gov/site/dca/talk-money/student-loans.page)
Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF)
The Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) program forgives the remaining balance on your Direct Loan. To qualify, you must: Work for a qualifying employer, such as a U.S. federal, state, local, or tribal government or non-profit Work full-time Make 120 qualifying monthly payments under a qualifying repayment plan while working for a qualifying employer [Learn more about PSLF.](https://studentaid.gov/manage-loans/forgiveness-cancellation/public-service) [Use the PSLF Help Tool.](https://studentaid.gov/pslf/) [Get answers to FAQs about PSLF.](https://www.nyc.gov/site/dca/consumers/Student-Loans-PSLF.page) [Check the status of your PSLF application.](https://studentaid.gov/help-center/answers/article/status-of-pslf-application)
One-Time Payment Count Adjustment
The U.S. Department of Education (U.S. ED) made a one-time payment count adjustment for: Borrowers in income-driven repayment (IDR) plans Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) program This adjustment gives credit toward loan forgiveness. You may get credit for: Any months in a repayment status Time spent in forbearance: 12 or more months of consecutive forbearance, or 36 or more months of cumulative forbearance Most deferments before 2013 and economic hardship deferments after 2013 Months before loan consolidation You will not get credit for time spent in: In-school deferment Grace period Default If you have these loans, you must consolidate them by April 30, 2024 to take advantage of the adjustment: Commercially held Federal Family Education Loans (FFEL) Federal Perkins Loans Federal Health Education Assistance Loans (HEAL) [Learn more about the count adjustment.](https://studentaid.gov/announcements-events/idr-account-adjustment)
SAVE Repayment Plan
The U.S. Department of Education (U.S. ED) runs the Saving on a Valuable Education (SAVE) Plan. The SAVE Plan is an income-drive repayment plan. Following a federal court injunction, interest on federal student loans in the SAVE Plan began accruing on August 1, 2025 . These changes are part of U.S. ED's compliance with legal rulings that block provisions of the SAVE Plan, including the 0% interest rate previously applied to some borrowers. Borrowers are responsible for making monthly payments that include accrued interest and principal. U.S. ED encourages SAVE borrowers to begin transitioning to legally compliant repayment plans. [Learn more about the SAVE plan and student loan counseling.](https://www.nyc.gov/site/dca/consumers/Student-Loans.page)
Student Debt Relief Plan
The Supreme Court blocked the Biden-Harris Administration’s One-Time Student Loan Debt Relief Plan. This plan would have canceled up to $20,000 in student debt on federal student loans for low- and middle-income borrowers. Your student loans are not eligible for student loan cancellation under this program. This is true even if you got confirmation or acceptance of submitted application. [Learn more about student loan forgiveness.](https://www2.ed.gov/fund/grants-college.html)
Summer Student Debt Partnership
New York City residents have free access to Summer, an online platform that helps you manage your student debt. You can use Summer to verify eligibility for programs that lower your monthly student loan payments, compare repayment options, manage your paperwork for enrollment in federal programs, and stay on track for loan forgiveness. [Learn more about the Summer Student Debt Partnership.](https://www.meetsummer.com/nyc-saveoncollege)

title: Electric Space Heater Sale Complaint
body:
An electric space heater is a portable device you plug into an outlet to warm a room. In New York City, it is illegal to sell these devices without required safety features or disclosures on the package. To prevent fires, an electric space heater must: Have a thermostat to control the temperature Shut off automatically if it tips over or gets too hot Be listed and labeled by a nationally recognized testing laboratory or other approved organization Information about these safety features must be on the package. Report the sale of electric space heaters that do not meet these requirements by:
Bodega, deli, or convenience store
Department store or megastore
Electronics store
Gas station convenience store
General vendor
Home appliance store

Restaurant Surcharge Complaints
Restaurants may not add a surcharge (extra charge) to the food or beverage prices listed on the menu. Restaurants may charge a bona fide service charge, but the charge must be clearly disclosed before you order food. Acceptable service charges include: Charge to split a single meal on multiple plates Minimum per person charge Mandatory gratuity for parties of eight or more
Report a problem with a restaurant surcharge.

title: Salary Transparency Law
body:
As of November 1, 2022, employers with four or more employees are required to include a pay range in job advertisements. Employers with one or more domestic workers are also required to comply.  Any advertisement for a job, promotion or transfer opportunity within New York City is covered by the law.  Temporary help firms are not required to comply with this law. Temporary help firms are businesses that recruit, hire, and assign their own employees to: Perform work or services for other organizations Support or supplement the other organization’s workforce Assist in special work situations Employers working with temporary help firms must follow the new law. [Learn more about the Salary Transparency Law.](https://www.nyc.gov/site/cchr/media/pay-transparency.page) You can learn about your rights and sign up for a free workshop. You can also file a complaint. Anonymous tips are accepted.

title: باللغة العربية NYC311 التواصل مع
body:
هل تحتاج إلى شيء آخر لتقديم شكوى بخصوص وكالة من وكالات المدينة لم تفِ باحتياجاتك اللغوية، استخدم صفحة [City Agency Language Access Feedback](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/article/?kanumber=KA-02630#googtrans(ar)) تفخر نيويورك بأنها واحدة من أكثر المدن تنوعًا على مستوى العالم. ونحن في NYC311 نعمل على تقديم الخدمات بأكثر عدد ممكن من اللغات، بما فيها اللغة العربية.
ما هو NYC311؟ يوفر NYC311 إمكانية الوصول السهل والسريع إلى الخدمات والمعلومات الخاصة بحكومة المدينة. وبإمكاننا مساعدتك فيما يخص مجموعة واسعة من الخدمات والمشاكل، مثل جمع القمامة، ومخالفات وقوف السيارات، والضوضاء.  اتصل بنا للتعرف على خدمات المدينة أو لتقديم طلبات خدمة. يمكنك التواصل مع NYC311 على مدار 24 ساعة طوال الأسبوع في جميع أيام السنة.
ما الفرق بين NYC311 و911؟ NYC311 عبارة عن خدمات للمدينة في غير أوقات الطوارئ. اتصل هاتفيًا على الرقم 911 في حالات الطوارئ، مثل الجرائم أثناء وقت وقوعها أو الظروف الخطرة، التي تتطلب استجابة عاجلة من الشرطة أو إدارة مكافحة الحرائق أو خدمات الطوارئ الطبية (Emergency Medical Services, EMS). بإمكان كل من NYC311 و911 تقديم الخدمات باللغة العربية بمساعدة من المترجمين الشفويين.
لاتصال هاتفيًا بـ NYC311 كمتحدث بالعربية مركز الاتصالات الهاتفية لـ NYC311 يقدم الخدمة بأكثر من 175 لغة، بما فيها اللغة العربية. ونحن نستخدم خدمة الترجمة الشفوية لمساعدتنا في التحدث إلى المتصلين بلغات غير الإنجليزية. للحصول على مساعدة من NYC311 باللغة العربية: •    داخل مدينة نيويورك: اتصل هاتفيًا على الرقم 311  •    خارج مدينة نيويورك، بما في ذلك دوليًا: اتصل هاتفيًا على الرقم 9675-639-212-1+ عند الاتصال بـ NYC311، سيتم الرد على مكالمتك من قبل نظام آلي باللغة الإنجليزية. وبعد حوالي 10 ثوانٍ من التسجيل، ستسمع قائمةً بخيارات اللغات المختلفة. للغة العربية، يرجى الضغط على 9 ثم 1 للتحدث إلى أحد الممثلين. وسيقوم المندوب بإحضار مترجم شفوي في المكالمة يتحدث بالعربية. سيقدم المترجم الفوري المساعدة لك وللمندوب في التحدث إلى بعضكما البعض.
استخدام الموقع الإلكتروني لـ     NYC311 كمتحدث بالعربية يقدم موقع NYC311 عبر الإنترنت خدمات الترجمة من خلال Google Translate. يمكن لهذه الأداة ترجمة موقعنا الإلكتروني إلى أكثر من 100 لغة، بما في ذلك عربي. يرجى ملاحظة أن خدمة Google Translate لا يمكنها ترجمة جميع أنواع المستندات. لا يضمن NYC311 دقة الترجمة المقدمة بواسطة هذه الأداة. ننصحك بالاتصال بالرقم 311 للتحقق من أي معلومات حيوية. لاستخدام الأداة، ابحث عن أيقونة الترجمة في أعلى الجانب الأيمن لكل صفحة.    انقر على الأيقونة، ثم حدد Arabic من القائمة. للتعرف على قائمة كاملة بالخدمات التي يقدمها NYC311 على الإنترنت، تفضل بزيارة صفحتنا [Browse Topics](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/resources/#googtrans(ar)).

title: বাংলায় NYC311 এর সাথে সংযুক্ত হন
body:
অন্যকিছু প্রয়োজন? আপনার ভাষার প্রয়োজনীয়তা পূরণ করেনি এমন একটি সিটি এজেন্সি সম্পর্কে একটি অভিযোগ করতে, [City Agency Language Access Feedback](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/article/?kanumber=KA-02630#googtrans(bn)) পৃষ্ঠাটি ব্যবহার করুন। বিশ্বের অন্যতম একটি বৈচিত্রময় শহর হওয়ার জন্য নিউ ইয়র্ক গর্বিত। NYC311 এ, বাংলা সহ, আমরা যথাসম্ভব বেশি সংখ্যক ভাষায় পরিষেবাগুলো দেওয়ার জন্য কাজ করি।
NYC311 কী?
NYC311, সিটির সরকারি পরিষেবাসমূহ এবং তথ্যে দ্রুত এবং সহজ অ্যাক্সেস প্রদান করে। আমরা আপনাকে বর্জ্য সংগ্রহ, পার্কিং টিকিট এবং কোলাহলের মতো বহুবিধ পরিষেবা এবং সমস্যা সম্পর্কে সহায়তা করতে পারি। সিটির পরিষেবাসেবাসমূহ সম্পর্কে জানতে বা পরিষেবার অনুরোধ ফাইল করতে আমাদের সাথে যোগাযোগ করুন। আপনি দিনের মধ্যে 24 ঘণ্টা, সপ্তাহের 7 দিন, বছরের 365 দিন, NYC311 এর সাথে যোগাযোগ করতে পারবেন।
NYC311 এবং 911 এর মধ্যে পার্থক্য কী?
NYC311 হল নন-এমার্জেন্সি সিটি পরিষেবা। ঘটতে থাকা অপরাধ বা বিপজ্জনক পরিস্থিতি, যার জন্য অবিলম্বে পুলিশ, দমকল বিভাগ বা জরুরি চিকিৎসা পরিষেবার (Emergency Medical Services, EMS) হস্তক্ষেপ আবশ্যক এমন পরিস্থিতিগুলোর মতো জরুরি অবস্থায় 911 নম্বরে কল করুন।  NYC311 এবং 911 উভয়েই দোভাষীর সহায়তায় বাংলায় পরিষেবা প্রদান করতে পারবে।
একজন বাংলা-ভাষী হিসেবে NYC311 এ কল করুন
NYC311 কল সেন্টার, বাংলা সহ 175টিরও বেশি ভাষায় পরিষেবা অফার করে। কলারদের সাথে ইংরেজি ছাড়া অন্য ভাষায় কথা বলতে সহায়তা পাওয়ার জন্য আমরা একজন দোভাষীকে ব্যবহার করি। বাংলায় NYC311 এর থেকে সহায়তা পেতে: NYC-এর ভিতরে: 311 নম্বরে ডায়াল করুন  NYC-এর বাইরে, আন্তর্জাতিক সহ: ডায়াল করুন +1-212-639-9675 আপনি যখন NYC311 এ কল করেন তখন একটি স্বয়ংক্রিয় পদ্ধতিতে ইংরেজিতে আপনার কলের উত্তর দেওয়া হয়। রেকর্ডিংয়ে আনুমানিক 10 সেকেন্ড পরে, আপনি বিভিন্ন ভাষার বিকল্পের একটি তালিকা শুনতে পারবেন। বাংলার জন্য 9 টিপুন এবং তারপর একজন প্রতিনিধির সাথে কথা বলতে 2 টিপুন। প্রতিনিধিটি বাংলাভাষী একজন দোভাষীকে কলে নিয়ে আসবেন। দোভাষীটি আপনাকে এবং প্রতিনিধিটিকে একে অপরের সাথে কথা বলতে সহায়তা করবেন।
একজন বাংলা-ভাষী হিসেবে NYC311 এর ওয়েবসাইট ব্যবহার করুন
NYC311 অনলাইন Google Translate মাধ্যমে অনুবাদ পরিষেবা প্রদান করে। এই টুলটি আমাদের ওয়েবসাইটকে বাংলা সহ 100 টিরও বেশি ভাষায় অনুবাদ করতে পারে । অনুগ্রহ করে মনে রাখবেন যে Google Translate সব ধরণের নথি অনুবাদ করতে পারে না। NYC311 এই টুলটির দ্বারা প্রদত্ত অনুবাদের নির্ভুলতার ক্ষেত্রে কোনো গ্যারান্টি দেয় না। আমরা আপনাকে আপনার যে কোনও গুরুত্বপূর্ণ তথ্য যাচাই করতে 311 -এ কল করার সুপারিশ করি। টুলটি ব্যবহার করতে, প্রতিটি পৃষ্ঠার ওপরের ডান-দিকের কোণে অনুবাদ আইনকটি খুঁজুন:  আইকনটিতে ক্লিক করুন, তারপর তালিকা থেকে Bengali নির্বাচন করুন। NYC311 এর অনলাইনে অফার করা পরিষেবাগুলির একটি সম্পূর্ণ তালিকার জন্য, আমাদের [Browse Topics](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/resources/#googtrans(bn)) পৃষ্ঠা ভিজিট করুন।

title: Connect with NYC311 in Other Languages
body:
Need something else? [City Agency Language Access Feedback](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/article/?kanumber=KA-02630) to make a complaint about a City agency that didn't meet your language needs [NYC311 Language Access](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/article/?kanumber=KA-03541) to learn how to connect with NYC311 in Arabic, Bengali, Chinese, French, Haitian Creole, Korean, Polish, Russian, Spanish, or Urdu New York is proud to be one of the most diverse cities in the world. At NYC311, we work to provide services in as many languages as possible.
What is NYC311?
NYC311 provides quick and easy access to City government services and information. We can help you with a broad range of services and issues, such as trash collection, parking tickets, and noise. Contact us to learn about City services or to file service requests. You can connect with NYC311 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, and 365 days a year.
What is the difference between NYC311 and 911?
NYC311 is for non-emergency City services. Call 911 for emergencies, such as crimes in progress or hazardous conditions, that require immediate response by the Police, Fire Department, or Emergency Medical Services (EMS). Both NYC311 and 911 can provide services in languages other than English with the help of interpreters.
Calling NYC311
The NYC311 Call Center offers service in more than 175 languages. We use an interpretation service to help us speak with callers in languages other than English. To get help from NYC311: Inside NYC: Dial 311 Outside NYC, including internationally: Dial +1-212-639-9675 When you call NYC311, your call will be answered by an automated system in English. About 30 seconds into the recording, you will hear a list of different language options. If you do not choose any of the options, your call will be transferred to a representative. If you need help in a language other than English, ask the representative for an interpreter. The representative will bring an interpreter on the call to help you and the representative speak to each other.
Using NYC311’s Website
NYC311 Online offers translation services through Google Translate. This tool can translate our website into more than 100 languages. Please note that Google Translate cannot translate all types of documents. NYC311 does not guarantee the accuracy of the translation provided by this tool. We recommend that you call 311 to verify any vital information.NYC311 Online offers translation services through Google Translate. This tool can translate our website into more than 100 languages. Please note that Google Translate cannot translate all types of documents. NYC311 does not guarantee the accuracy of the translation provided by this tool. We recommend that you call 311 to verify any vital information. To use the tool, look for the translate icon in the upper right-hand corner of each page. Click on the icon, then select your language from the list. For a complete list of the services NYC311 offers online, visit our [Browse Topics](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/resources/) page.

title: NYC311 Language Access
body:
New York is proud to be one of the most diverse cities in the world. In accordance with Local Law 30, NYC311 provides service in the Designated Citywide Languages, listed below. Beyond the languages below, this website can be translated into more than 100 languages using the menu at the top right corner of this page. This service is offered through Google Translate. Please note that Google Translate cannot translate all types of documents. NYC311 does not guarantee the accuracy of the translation provided by this tool. We recommend that you call 311 to verify any vital information. If your language is not available online, you can get help in more than 175 languages by calling 311. title: Contacter NYC311 en français
body:
Besoin d’autre chose ? Pour porter plainte contre un service municipal qui n’a pas répondu à vos besoins linguistiques, utilisez la page [City Agency Language Access Feedback](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/article/?kanumber=KA-02630#googtrans(fr)). New York est fière d’être l’une des villes les plus multiculturelles du monde. Chez NYC311, nous nous efforçons de fournir des services dans le plus grand nombre de langues possible, y compris le français.
Qu’est-ce que NYC311 ?
NYC311 permet d’accéder rapidement et facilement aux services et aux informations de l’administration municipale. Nous pouvons vous aider avec un large éventail de services ou répondre à vos questions, notamment sur la collecte des ordures ménagères, les tickets de stationnement et le bruit. Contactez-nous pour en savoir plus sur les services municipaux ou déposer des demandes de services. Vous pouvez contacter NYC311 24 h/24, 7 jours/7 et 365 jours/an.
Quelle est la différence entre NYC311 et le 911 ?
NYC311 est dédié aux services municipaux non urgents. Appelez le 911 pour les urgences, (p. ex. pour un crime en cours ou une situation dangereuse) nécessitant une intervention immédiate de la police, des pompiers ou des services médicaux d’urgence (Emergency Medical Services, EMS). NYC311 et le 911 peuvent fournir des services en français avec l’aide d’interprètes.
Appeler NYC311 en tant que francophone
Le centre d’appels NYC311 propose ses services dans plus de 175 langues, dont le français. Nous utilisons un service d’interprétariat pour nous aider à communiquer avec les personnes non anglophones qui nous appellent. Pour obtenir l’aide de NYC311 en français : À New York : composez le 311.  En dehors de New York, y compris à l’international : composez le 1-212-639-9675. Lorsque vous appelez NYC311, votre appel est traité an anglais, par un système automatisé. Environ 10 secondes après le début de l’enregistrement, la liste des différentes langues disponible vous est proposée. Pour sélectionner français, appuyez sur 9, et puis sur 3 pour communiquer avec un agent. L’agent demandera à un interprète parlant français de se joindre à l’appel. L’interprète vous aidera, vous et l’agent, à communiquer.
Utiliser le site internet de NYC311 en tant que francophone
NYC311 Online propose des services de traduction à l’aide de Google Translate. Cet outil peut traduire notre site internet dans plus de 100 langues, dont le français. Veuillez noter que Google Translate ne peut pas traduire tous les types de documents. NYC311 ne garantit pas l’exactitude de la traduction fournie par cet outil. Nous vous recommandons d’appeler le 311 pour vérifier toute information vitale. Pour utiliser cet outil, recherchez l’icône de traduction située dans le coin supérieur droit de chaque page: Cliquez sur l’icône, puis sélectionnez «French» dans la liste. Pour consulter la liste complète des services proposés en ligne par NYC311, rendez-vous sur la page [Browse Topics](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/resources/#googtrans(fr)).

title: 한국어로 NYC311과 소통하기
body:
다른 문의가 있습니까? 언어에 대한 요구를 충족하지 않은 시 기관에 대한 불만을 제기하려면 [City Agency Language Access Feedback](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/article/?kanumber=KA-02630#googtrans(ko)) 페이지를 이용하십시오. 뉴욕은 세계에서 가장 다양성 있는 도시 중 하나임을 자랑스럽게 생각합니다. NYC311은 한국어를 포함하여 최대한 많은 언어로 서비스를 제공하기 위해 노력합니다.
NYC311 소개
NYC311을 통해 시 기관 서비스 및 정보를 빠르고 쉽게 이용할 수 있습니다. 쓰레기 수거, 주차 티켓, 소음 등 폭넓은 서비스 및 문제에 대한 도움을 드립니다. 시 서비스에 대해 알아보거나 서비스 요청을 제출하려면 문의해주십시오. 연중무휴 24시간 NYC311과 소통하실 수 있습니다.
NYC311과 911의 차이점
NYC311은 비응급 시 서비스입니다. 경찰, 소방서, 응급 의료 서비스(Emergency Medical Services, EMS)의 즉각적인 대처가 필요한 범죄가 일어나고 있거나 위험한 상황 등 긴급 상황이 발생한 경우, 911번으로 전화하십시오. NYC311 및 911 모두 통역사의 도움을 통해 한국어로 서비스를 제공할 수 있습니다.
한국어 구사자의 NYC311 전화 연결
NYC311 콜센터는 한국어를 포함하여 175개 이상의 언어로 서비스를 제공합니다. 영어 이외의 언어 구사자와 소통할 때는 통역 서비스가 사용됩니다. 한국어로 NYC311 도움 받기: 뉴욕시 내: 311번으로 전화  해외 포함 뉴욕시 외부: +1-212-639-9675번으로 전화 NYC311에 전화하는 경우, 영어 자동 응답 시스템으로 연결됩니다. 자동 응답이 시작되고 약 10초 후, 다른 언어 옵션 목록을 들을 수 있습니다. 한국어의 경우, 7번을 눌러 담당자와 대화할 수 있습니다. 담당자가 통화에 한국어를 할 수 있는 통역사를 호출합니다. 통역사가 귀하 및 담당자의 소통을 지원합니다.
한국어 사용자의 NYC311 웹사이트 이용
NYC311 온라인은 Google Translate로 번역 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 툴은 저희 웹사이트를 한국어를 포함해 100개 이상의 언어로 번역합니다. Google Translate가 모든 종류의 문서를 번역할 수 없다는 점을 참고하시기 바랍니다. NYC311은 이 툴로 제공되는 번역 정확성을 보장하지 않습니다. 중요한 정보는 311에 전화해 확인하시는 걸 추천드립니다. 도구를 사용하려면 각 페이지의 오른쪽 상단 모서리에 있는 번역 버튼을 찾아보십시오. 아이콘을 클릭한 뒤, 목록에서 “Korean”를 선택합니다. NYC311이 온라인으로 제공하는 전체 서비스 목록은 [Browse Topics](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/resources/#googtrans(ko)) 페이지에서 확인할 수 있습니다.

title: Konekte avèk NYC311 an Kreyòl Ayisyen
body:
Ou bezwen yon lòt bagay? Pou pote plent kont yon ajans Minisipal ki pa te ede ou nan lang ou, itilize [City Agency Language Access Feedback](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/article/?kanumber=KA-02630#googtrans(ht)) paj la. New York fyè pou li se youn nan vil ki gen plis divèsite nan mond lan. Nan NYC311, nou ap travay pou nou founi sèvis nan pi plis lang posib, ak Kreyòl Ayisyen ladan.
Kisa NYC311 ye?
NYC311 founi aksè rapid ak fasil bay sèvis ak enfòmasyon Nou kapab ede ou nan yon pakèt sèvis epi ede ou rezoud plizyè pwoblèm, tankou ranmase pil fatra, kontravansyon paske ou mal pake, ak pil bri. Kontakte nou pou konnen plis sou sèvis vil la oswa pou ou ranpli papye pou mande sèvis. Ou kapab konekte avèk NYC311 24 sou 24, 7 jou sou 7, epi 365 jou ane a.
Ki diferans ki genyen ant NYC311 ak 911?
NYC311 se pou sèvis vil la ki pa ijan. Rele 911 pou ijans yo, tankou yon moun yo ap touye oswa sitiyasyon ki kapab danjere, ki nesesite entèvansyon Lapolis, Depatman Ponpye, oswa Sèvis Medikal an Ijans (Emergency Medical Services, EMS). NYC311 ak 911, toulède kapab founi sèvis an Kreyol Ayisyen avèk èd entèprèt yo.
Rele NYC311 si ou pale Kreyòl Ayisyen
Sant Apèl NYC311 a ofri sèvis nan plis pase 175 lang, gen ladan Kreyòl Ayisyen. Nou itilize yon sèvis entèpretasyon pou ede nou pale ak moun ki ap rele yo nan lòt lang ki pa Anglè. Pou jwenn èd NYC311 an Kreyòl Ayisyen: Si ou andedan vil New York: Konpoze 311  Si ou deyò Vil New York, tankou entènasyonal: Konpoze +1-212-639-9675 Lè ou rele NYC311, yon sistèm otomatik ap reponn apèl ou a an Anglè. Pandan yon 10 segond aprè anrejistreman kòmanse, ou ap tande yon lis opsyon lang diferan. Pou Kreyòl Ayisyen, peze 8 pou pale ak yon reprezantan. Reprezantan ap mete yon entèprèt ki pale Kreyòl Ayisyen sou liy lan. Entèprèt la ap ede ou menm ak reprezantan pale youn ak lòt.
Itilize sit entènèt NYC311 la si ou pale Kreyòl Ayisyen
NYC311 Online ofri sèvis tradiksyon atravè Google Translate. Zouti sa a kapab tradui sitwèb nou an nan plis pase 100 lang, tankou kreyòl ayisyen. Tanpri sonje Google Translate pa kapab tradui tout kalite dokiman. NYC311 pa garanti tradiksyon zouti sa a bay ap sanpousan. Nou rekòmande pou w rele 311 pou verifye nenpòt enfòmasyon enpòtan. Pou itilize zouti a, chèche senbòl tradiksyon an nan kwen anlè sou bò dwat chak paj: Klike sou senbòl la, epi seleksyone “Haitian Creole” nan lis la. Pou yon lis sèvis konplè anliy, vizite [Browse Topics](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/resources/#googtrans(ht)) paj NYC311 la.

title: Nawiąż kontakt z NYC311 po polsku
body:
Potrzebujesz czegoś jeszcze? Aby złożyć skargę na agencję miejscką, która nie spełniała Twoich potrzeb językowych, skorzystaj ze strony [City Agency Language Access Feedback](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/article/?kanumber=KA-02630#googtrans(pl)). Nowy Jork jest dumny z tego, że jest jednym z najbardziej zróżnicowanych miast na świecie. W NYC311 staramy się świadczyć usługi w jak największej liczbie języków, w tym języku polskim.
Czym jest NYC311?
NYC311 zapewnia szybki i łatwy dostęp do usług i informacji władz miejskich. Pomożemy Ci w szerokim zakresie usług i problemów, takich jak wywóz śmieci, mandaty parkingowe i hałas. Skontaktuj się z nami, aby dowiedzieć się więcej o usługach miejskich lub złożyć wnioski o usługi. Możesz nawiązać kontakt z NYC311 24 godziny na dobę, 7 dni w tygodniu przez 365 dni w roku.
Jaka jest różnica między NYC311 a numerem 911?
NYC311 służy do usług miejskich w sytuacjach innych niż nagłe. Zadzwoń pod numer 911 w nagłych wypadkach, takich jak przestępstwa w toku lub niebezpieczne warunki, które wymagają natychmiastowej reakcji policji, straży pożarnej lub ratownictwa medycznego (Emergency Medical Services, EMS). Zarówno NYC311, jak i numer 911 mogą świadczyć usługi w języku polskim z pomocą tłumaczy.
Zadzwoń do NYC311 jako osoba polskojęzyczna
Centrum telefoniczne NYC311 oferuje obsługę w ponad 175 językach, w tym w języku polskim. Korzystamy z usługi tłumaczenia ustnego, aby umożliwić rozmowę z dzwoniącymi, którzy mówią w językach innych niż angielski. Aby uzyskać pomoc od NYC311 w języku polskim: W mieście Nowy Jork: Zadzwoń pod 311  Poza miastem Nowy Jork, również poza granicami USA: Zadzwoń pod numer +1-212-639-9675 Gdy zadzwonisz do NYC311, Twoje połączenie zostanie odebrane przez automatyczny system w języku angielskim. Po mniej więcej 10 sekundach nagrania usłyszysz listę różnych opcji językowych. W przypadku języka polskiego naciśnij 9, a następnie 4, aby porozmawiać z przedstawicielem. Przedstawiciel ten przyprowadzi na rozmowę tłumacza, który mówi po polsku. Tłumacz pomoże Tobie i przedstawicielowi w rozmowie.
Użyj strony internetowej NYC311 jako osoba polskojęzyczna
NYC311 Online oferuje usługi tłumaczeniowe za pomocą Google Translate. To narzędzie może przetłumaczyć naszą stronę internetową na ponad 100 języków, w tym język polski. Informujemy, że Google Translate nie może tłumaczyć wszystkich typów dokumentów. NYC311 nie gwarantuje dokładności tłumaczenia zapewnianego przez to narzędzie. To narzędzie może przetłumaczyć naszą stronę internetową na ponad 100 języków, w tym język polski. Informujemy, że Google Translate nie może tłumaczyć wszystkich typów dokumentów. NYC311 nie gwarantuje dokładności tłumaczenia zapewnianego przez to narzędzie. Zalecamy zadzwonienie pod numer 311 w celu weryfikacji wszelkich istotnych informacji. Aby skorzystać z tego narzędzia, poszukaj ikony tłumaczenia w prawym górnym rogu każdej strony:  Kliknij ikonę, a następnie wybierz z listy „Polish”. Pełną listę usług internetowych oferowanych przez NYC311 można znaleźć na naszej [Browse Topics](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/resources/#googtrans(pl)) stronie.

title: Обратитесь за помощью в NYC311 на русском языке
body:
Нужна другая помощь? Чтобы подать жалобу на агентство города, которое не соответствует вашим языковым требованиям, используйте страницу [City Agency Language Access Feedback](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/article/?kanumber=KA-02630#googtrans(ru)). Нью-Йорк гордится тем, что является одним из самых многонациональных городов мира. Мы в NYC311 стараемся предоставлять услуги на максимальном количестве языков, в том числе на русском.
Что такое NYC311?
NYC311 обеспечивает быстрый и легкий доступ к городским государственным услугам и информации города. Мы можем помочь вам с широким спектром услуг и проблем, таких как вывоз мусора, штрафы за нарушение правил парковки и шум. Свяжитесь с нами, чтобы узнать о городских услугах или подать заявку на обслуживание. Вы можете обращаться с NYC311 круглосуточно без выходных и праздников.
В чем отличие NYC311 от 911?
NYC311 предназначен для связи с неэкстренными городскими службами. Звоните по номеру 911 в экстренных случаях, таких как совершение преступления или опасные условия, которые требуют немедленного реагирования со стороны полиции, пожарной охраны или службы неотложной медицинской помощи (Emergency Medical Services, EMS). И служба NYC311, и служба 911 могут предоставлять услуги на русском языке с помощью устных переводчиков.
Позвоните в NYC311 как русскоязычный пользователь
Колл-центр NYC311 предлагает услуги на более чем 175 языках, включая русский. Мы используем услуги устного перевода, чтобы помочь нам общаться с абонентами, которые говорят на языках, отличных от английского. Чтобы получить помощь от NYC311 на русском языке: в Нью-Йорке: наберите 311;  за пределами Нью-Йорка, в том числе за границей: наберите +1-212-639-9675. Когда ваш звонок поступает в NYC311, на него отвечает автоматизированная система на английском языке. Примерно через 10 секунд после начала воспроизведения записи вы услышите список различных языковых вариантов. Чтобы поговорить с представителем на русском языке, нажмите 4. Сотрудник службы подсоединит к вызову устного переводчика, говорящего на русском языке. Устный переводчик поможет вам и сотруднику службы в ходе коммуникации.
Используйте веб-сайт NYC311 как русскоязычный пользователь
NYC311 Online предлагает услуги перевода веб-сайта при помощи Google Translate. Этот инструмент может переводить информацию с нашего веб-сайта на более чем 100 языков, среди которых и русский. Обратите внимание, что Google Translate не может переводить все виды документов. NYC311 не гарантирует точность его перевода. Мы рекомендуем уточнять важную информацию по номеру 311. Чтобы использовать этот инструмент, найдите значок перевода в правом верхнем углу каждой страницы: Нажмите на значок, затем выберите “Russian” из списка. Полный список услуг, которые NYC311 предлагает онлайн, см. на нашей странице [Browse Topics](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/resources/#googtrans(ru)).

title: Comuníquese con NYC311 en español
body:
¿Necesita algo más? Para presentar una queja sobre una agencia de la ciudad que no haya cubierto sus necesidades con el idioma, use la página [City Agency Language Access Feedback](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/article/?kanumber=KA-02630#googtrans(es)). Nueva York se enorgullece de ser una de las ciudades más diversas del mundo. En NYC311, trabajamos para prestar servicios en la mayor cantidad de idiomas posible, incluyendo el español.
¿Qué es NYC311?
NYC311 ofrece un acceso rápido y fácil a los servicios e información del gobierno de la ciudad. Podemos ayudarlo con una amplia gama de servicios y asuntos, como recogida de basura, multas de estacionamiento y ruido. Comuníquese con nosotros para conocer los servicios de la ciudad o para presentar solicitudes de servicio. Puede comunicarse con NYC311 las 24 horas del día, los 7 días de la semana y los 365 días del año.
¿Cuál es la diferencia entre NYC311 y 911?
NYC311 es para servicios municipales que no son de emergencia. Llame al 911 para emergencias, como delitos en curso o condiciones peligrosas, que requieran una respuesta inmediata de la policía, los bomberos o los servicios médicos de emergencia (Emergency Medical Services, EMS). Tanto NYC311 como 911 pueden prestar servicios en español con la ayuda de intérpretes.
Llame a NYC311 como hablante de español
NYC311 Call Center ofrece servicio en más de 175 idiomas, incluido el español. Usamos un servicio de interpretación para que nos ayude a hablar con las personas que llaman en otros idiomas que no sean el inglés. Para obtener ayuda de NYC311 en español: Dentro de NYC: marque 311 Fuera de NYC, incluso a nivel internacional: marque +1-212-639-9675 Cuando llame a NYC311, un sistema automatizado le responderá en inglés. A los 10 segundos de la grabación, escuchará una lista con opciones de idiomas. Para el español, presione 3 para hablar con un representante. El representante traerá un intérprete en la llamada que habla español. El intérprete lo ayudará a usted y al representante a hablar entre sí.
Use el sitio web de NYC311 como hablante de español
NYC311 Online ofrece servicios de traducción a través de Google Translate. Esta herramienta puede traducir nuestro sitio web a más de 100 idiomas, incluido ESPAÑOL. Tenga en cuenta que Google Translate no puede traducir todos los tipos de documentos. NYC311 no garantiza la precisión de la traducción proporcionada por esta herramienta. Le recomendamos que llame al 311 para verificar cualquier información vital. Para usar la herramienta, busque el icono de traducción en la esquina superior derecha de cada página: Haga clic en el ícono y seleccione “Spanish” en la lista. Para obtener una lista completa de los servicios que NYC311 ofrece en línea, visite nuestra página [Browse Topics](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/resources/#googtrans(es)).

title: کے ساتھ اردو میں جڑیں NYC311
body:
کچھ اور درکار ہے؟ سٹی کی جو ایجنسی آپ کی لسانی ضرورتیں پوری نہیں کرتی ہے اس کے بارے میں شکایت درج کرانے کے لیے، [City Agency Language Access Feedback](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/article/?kanumber=KA-02630#googtrans(ur)) صفحہ استعمال کریں۔ نیو یارک کو دنیا میں سب سے متنوع شہروں میں سے ایک ہونے پر فخر ہے۔ NYC311 پر، ہم اردو سمیت، ممکن حد تک زیادہ سے زیادہ زبانوں میں خدمات فراہم کرنے کا کام کرتے ہیں۔
NYC311 کیا ہے؟ NYC311 سٹی کی سرکاری خدمات اور معلومات کی فوری اور آسان رسائی فراہم کرتی ہے۔ ہم آپ کو وسیع پیمانے کی خدمات اور مسائل، جیسے کچرا اٹھانا، پارکنگ کے ٹکٹ، اور شور کے معاملے آپ کی مدد کر سکتے ہیں۔ سٹی کی خدمات کے بارے میں جاننے کے لیے یا خدمت کی درخواستیں دائر کرنے کے لیے ہم سے رابطہ کریں۔ آپ NYC311 سے روزانہ 24 گھنٹے، ہفتے کے 7 دن، اور سال کے 365 دن جڑ سکتے ہیں۔
NYC311 اور 911 کے بیچ کیا فرق ہے؟ NYC311 سٹی کی غیر ہنگامی خدمات کے لیے ہے۔ 911 ایسے ہنگامی حالات، جیسے رواں جرائم یا مضرر حالات کے لیے ہے جن کے لیے پولیس، فائر ڈپارٹمنٹ یا ہنگامی طبی خدمات (Emergency Medical Services, EMS) کی طرف سے فوری جوابی اقدام مطلوب ہوتا ہے۔ NYC311 اور 911 دونوں ہی ترجمانوں کی مدد سے اردو میں خدمات فراہم کرتے ہیں۔
اردو داں کے بطور NYC311 کو کال کریں NYC311 کا کال سنٹر اردو سمیت 175 سے زائد زبانوں میں خدمت پیش کرتی ہے۔ ہم انگریزی کے علاوہ زبانوں میں کالرز کے ساتھ بات کرنے میں اپنی مدد کے لیے ترجمانی کی خدمت کا استعمال کرتے ہیں۔ اردو میں NYC311 سے مدد حاصل کرنے کے لیے: NYC کے اندر: 311 ڈائل کریں  NYC سے باہر، بشمول بین الاقوامی سطح پر: +1-212-639-9675 ڈائل کریں جب آپ ‏NYC311‏ پر کال کریں گے تو، آّپ کی کال کا جواب انگریزی میں ایک خود کار نظام کے ذریعے دیا جائے گا۔ ریکارڈنگ میں لگ بھگ 10 سیکنڈ پر، آپ مختلف زبانوں کے اختیارات کی ایک فہرست سنیں گے۔ اردو کے لئے 9 دبائیں نمائندہ سے بات کرنے کے لئے پھر 5 دبائیں۔ نمائندہ اردو بولنے والے ایک ترجمان کو کال پر لائے گا۔ ترجمان ایک دوسرے سے بات کرنے میں آپ کی اور نمائندہ کی مدد کرے گا۔
اردو داں کے بطور NYC311 کی ویب سائٹ استعمال کریں۔ NYC311 آن لائن ترجمہ کی خدمات Google Translate کی معرفت پیش کرتا ہے۔ یہ ٹول اردو سمیت، 100 سے زائد زبانوں میں ہماری سائٹ کا ترجمہ کر سکتا ہے۔ براہ کرم نوٹ کر لیں کہ Google Translate تمام اقسام کی دستاویزات کا ترجمہ نہیں کر سکتا۔ NYC311 اس ٹول کی طرف سے فراہم کردہ ترجمہ کی درستی کی ضمانت نہیں دیتا ہے۔ ہماری تجویز ہے کہ کسی بھی اہم معلومات کی تصدیق کے لیے آپ 311 پر کال کریں۔ ٹول استعمال کرنے کے لیے، ہر صفحہ کے اوپری دائیں طرف کے کونے میں ترجمہ کریں کے آئیکن پر نظر ڈالیں۔   آئیکن پر کلک کریں، پھر فہرست سے “Urdu” کو منتخب کریں۔ NYC311 جو خدمات پیش کرتی ہے ان کی مکمل فہرست کے لیے، ہمارا [Browse Topics](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/resources/#googtrans(ur)) صفحہ ملاحظہ کریں۔

title: 使用中文與 NYC311 聯絡
body:
您是否需要別的説明？ 如需針對未滿足您的語言需求的市政機構提 出投訴，請訪問 [City Agency Language Access Feedback](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/article/?kanumber=KA-02630#googtrans(zh-TW)) 頁面。 紐約很榮幸能成為世界上最具多樣化的城 市之一。  在 NYC311，我們致力於提供盡可能多的語言 服務（包括中文）。
什麼是 NYC311？
NYC311 為獲取市政府服務和資訊的人士提 供快捷、簡便的通道。我們可以幫助您獲取範圍廣泛的服務和解決各種各樣的問題， 例如垃圾清理、停車罰單，以及噪音問題。 如需瞭解市政服務或提交服務申請， 請與我們聯絡。您可以隨時聯絡 NYC311， 我們的服務時間為全年全天候 24 小時無休。
NYC311 和 911 有什麼不同？
NYC311 提供非緊急的市政服務。您可在遇到需要警局、消防部門或緊急醫療服務 (Emergency Medical Services, EMS) 立即回應的緊急情況時致電 911，例如正在進行中的犯罪或危險狀況。  NYC311 和 911 均可在譯員的説明下提供中 文服務。
如果您是中文使用者，您也可以致電 NYC311
NYC311 呼叫中心 提供超過 175 種語言的服務，包括中文。我們使用翻譯服務來説明與非英語語言使用者的來電交流。 如需獲取 NYC311 中文版本的幫助： 紐約市內：請撥打 311  紐約市外，包括國外：請撥打 +1-212-639-9675 当您致电 NYC311 时，您的来电将由英语自动系统予以应答。在约 10 秒的录音播放完毕后，您将听到不同语言选项的列表。如需普通话服务，请按 5 与代表通话。 當您致電 NYC311 時，您的來電將由英語自動系統予以應答。在約 10 秒的錄音播放完畢後，您將聽到不同語言選項的清單。如需廣東話服務，請按 6 與代表通話。 我們的代表將派出能使用您所需中文方言的譯員來回應您的來電。譯員將説明您和代表進 行對話。
如果您是中文使用者，您也可以造訪 NYC311 的網站
NYC311 Online 透過 Google Translate 提供翻譯服務。此工具可將我們的網站翻譯成 100 多種語言，包括 繁體中文。請注意，Google Translate 無法翻譯所有類型的文件。NYC311 不對此工具提供的翻譯內容保證準確性。我們建議您撥打 311 來確認任何重要資訊。 如需使用這個工具，請查找每個頁面右上角的翻譯圖示： 按一按圖示，然後從清單中選擇「[Chinese – Simplified]」或「[Chinese - Traditional]」。 如需獲取 NYC311 所提供線上服務的完整清單，請造訪我們的 [Browse Topics](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/resources/#googtrans(zh-TW)) 頁面。

title: 使用中文与 NYC311 联系
body:
您是否需要别的帮助？ 如需针对未满足您的语言需求的市政机构提 出投诉，请访问 [City Agency Language Access Feedback](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/article/?kanumber=KA-02630#googtrans(zh-CN)) 页面。 纽约很荣幸能成为世界上最具多样化的城市之一。 在 NYC311，我们致力于提供尽可能多的语言服务（包括中文）。
什么是 NYC311？
NYC311 为访问市政府服务和信息的人士提供 快捷、简便的通道。我们可以帮助您获取范围广泛的服务和解决各种各样的问题，例如垃圾清理、 停车罚单，以及噪音问题。 如需了解市政服务或提交服务申请， 请与我们联系。您可以随时联系 NYC311， 我们的服务时间为全年全天候 24 小时无休。
NYC311 和 911 有什么不同？
NYC311 提供非紧急的市政服务。您可在遇到需要警局、消防部门或紧急医疗服务 (Emergency Medical Services, EMS) 立即响应的紧急情况时致电 911，例如正在进行中的犯罪或危险状况。  NYC311 和 911 均可在译员的帮助下提 供中文服务。
如果您是中文使用者，您也可以致电 NYC311
NYC311 呼叫中心提供超过 175 种语言的服务，包括中文。我们使用翻译服务来帮助与非英语语言使用者的来电交流。 如需获取 NYC311 中文版本的帮助： 纽约市内：请拨打 311  纽约市外，包括国外：请拨打 +1-212-639-9675 当您致电 NYC311 时，您的来电将由英语自动系统予以应答。在约 10 秒的录音播放完毕后，您将听到不同语言选项的列表。如需普通话服务，请按 5 与代表通话。 當您致電 NYC311 時，您的來電將由英語自動系統予以應答。在約 10 秒的錄音播放完畢後，您將聽到不同語言選項的清單。如需廣東話服務，請按 6 與代表通話。 我们的代表将派出能使用您所需中文方言的译员來应答您的来电。译员将帮助您和代表进 行对话。
如果您是中文使用者，您也可以访问 NYC311 的网站
NYC311 在线服务通过谷歌翻译提供翻译服务。该工具可以将我们的网站翻译成 100 多种语言，包括 简体中文. 请注意，谷歌翻译无法翻译所有类型的文件。NYC311 不保证该工具所提供翻译的准确性。我们建议您致电 311 以核实任何重要信息。 如需使用这个工具，请查找每个页面右上角的翻译图标： 点击图标，然后从列表中选择“[Chinese – Simplified]”或“[Chinese - Traditional]”。 如需获取 NYC311 所提供在线服务的完整列表。请访问我们的 [Browse Topics](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/resources/#googtrans(zh-CN)) 页面。

title: Clean Energy Systems Exemption
body:
New York State offers the Clean Energy Systems Property Tax. This tax exemption is meant to encourage the installation of clean energy systems in residential and commercial properties. Under this exemption, your property taxes will not increase as a result of installing a clean energy system. This is for a period of 15 years. [Learn more about the Clean Energy Systems Exemption](https://www.nyserda.ny.gov/).
Eligibility
Eligible energy systems include: Solar or wind energy Farm waste energy Micro-hydroelectric energy Fuel cell electric generating system Micro-combined heat and power generating equipment system Electric Energy Storage System Fuel-flexible linear generator electric generating system [View Real Property Tax Law Section 487 (1) to learn more.](https://www.nysenate.gov/legislation/laws/RPT/487)
Apply
To apply: Review the RP 487 instruction sheet to make sure you are following program rules File a Notice of Intent to Construct Clean Energy Systems Complete and submit the RP 487 Application for Tax Exemption of Solar, Wind, or Certain Other Energy Systems Make two copies of the application The first copy is for the Department of Finance (DOF) The second copy is for New York State Energy Research and Development Authority (NYSERDA) Department of Finance Property Exemptions Administration - Commercial Exemptions 59 Maiden Lane, 22nd Floor New York, NY 10038 [Download the RP 487 Instruction Sheet.](https://www.tax.ny.gov/pdf/current_forms/orpts/rp487i.pdf) [Download the RP 487 Application for Tax Exemption of Solar, Wind, or Certain Other Energy Systems.](https://www.tax.ny.gov/pdf/current_forms/orpts/rp487_fill_in.pdf) Visit the [New York State website](https://www.nyserda.ny.gov/) to learn more.
Deadline
The deadline for the following is January 5: The application The Notice of Intent to Construct Clean Energy Systems These documents must be received or post-marked by this date. This is for benefits to begin on July 1 of the year you apply.
Get Help
Online [Contact the Department of Finance.](https://www.nyc.gov/site/finance/about/contact-us.page)

title: MyCity
body:
Need something else? [Child Care Financial Assistance](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/article/?kanumber=KA-03118) for free and low-cost options, application status, and help with your MyCity child care application [Public Benefit Fair Hearing](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/article/?kanumber=KA-02943) to request an appeal if you were denied financial assistance for child care The Office of Technology and Innovation (OTI) has launched the MyCity website. MyCity helps New Yorkers easily search, apply for, and track City services and benefits. Users can also securely save their information and documents to their account for future applications. MyCity can be translated into 10 languages. The NYC childcare financial assistance application as well as streamlined business services are available through MyCity. OTI will continue developing MyCity with other City agencies and based on feedback from the public. Visit [mycity.nyc.gov](https://mycity.nyc.gov) to learn more.
Create an Account
You can create a MyCity account by creating: An NYC.ID, or By using an email or userID that you already have with an application, such as Google or Microsoft.  Using an existing ID or userID other than NYC.ID is called using a "third-party application." NYC.ID Login Follow these steps to create a MyCity account and log-in with NYC.ID: Go to the [MyCity homepage](https://mycity.nyc.gov). Click the  Login Or Create an Account  link in the top right menu. Click the  Create Account  link under the login fields. Fill in the NYC.ID account creation form and then click  Create Account . If you created an account using your email, check your inbox for the automated email to validate your email address. Third-Party Login Follow these steps to create a MyCity account using a third-party login: Go to the [MyCity homepage](https://mycity.nyc.gov). Click the  Login Or Create an Account  link in the top right menu. Locate and click your preferred  third-party application  and select the account you want to use to access your MyCity account in the future. Follow the prompts provided by your selected  third-party application  to activate your MyCity account. Once you have logged in, complete the profile to set up your account: Fill out the form with your personal information. Check the box under Terms  to indicate your consent to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy. Click the Create Account  button at the bottom of the page.
Technical Assistance
The MyCity website works best when using a desktop computer, laptop computer, or mobile device with internet access. You can contact the MyCity Support Team online if you need technical assistance with the MyCity website. Online [Contact the MyCity Support Team.](https://mycity.nyc.gov/contact-us) By Phone
Call [311](tel:311) or 212-NEW-YORK [(212-639-9675)](tel:2126399675) for help.
MyCity Feedback
You can provide general feedback about the MyCity website to the Office of Technology and Innovation (OTI). Please note that the form is not for MyCity technical assistance. Online Submit general feedback about the [MyCity website](https://mycity.nyc.gov/contact-us). By Phone
Call [311](tel:311) or 212-NEW-YORK [(212-639-9675)](tel:2126399675) for help.

title: Big Apple Connect
body:
NYC’s Office of Technology and Innovation officially launched Big Apple Connect in September 2022 to ensure that NYCHA residents have access to free, fast, reliable, and safe internet. NYCHA residents without existing home internet can sign up for Big Apple Connect with either Optimum or Spectrum (service provider will depend on where you live). Existing Optimum and Spectrum customers will have their bills reduced to as low as $0, as monthly internet and basic cable TV charges are eliminated.   NYCHA residents in eligible developments can receive the following for free: Internet connections with download speeds of up to 300 Mbps Wireless router Modem Basic cable TV Cable box and remote control Residents of select NYCHA developments are eligible to enroll in Big Apple Connect. More developments will be added throughout 2023. More information, including the full list of eligible NYCHA developments, is available online. You can also get assistance by phone. Online
[Learn more about Big Apple Connect.](https://www.nyc.gov/assets/bigappleconnect/)
By Phone If you live in an eligible NYCHA development, you must contact the service provider that covers your development.
Agency: Optimum
Phone Number: (866) 580-1410
Business Hours: Monday - Saturday: 10 AM - 7 PM
Agency: Spectrum
Phone Number: (866) 960-1754
Business Hours: 24 hours, 7 days a week
NYCHA Tablet Program
With the majority of NYCHA residents now receiving free internet service through Big Apple Connect, the additional internet service provided through the tablet program for older adults living in NYCHA has ended.  All program users will be able to keep their tablets. Residents living in Big Apple Connect-eligible developments will be able to connect their tablets to the internet through their current at-home internet service provided by either Spectrum or Optimum.  If you have any questions, send an email to [tablets@oti.nyc.gov](mailto:tablets@oti.nyc.gov) with your name, address and phone number.

title: Short-Term Rental Registration
body:
Need something else? [Housing Used for Short-Term Rental (Vacation Rentals or Illegal Home-Sharing)](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/article/?kanumber=KA-02317) to report a location that is being used as a hotel, for vacation rentals, or for rentals of fewer than 30 days If you are a short-term rental host, you are required to register with the Mayor's Office of Special Enforcement (OSE) per Local Law 18. The application is currently open, and hosts are encouraged to submit an application well in advance of OSE beginning enforcement of this requirement after September 5, 2023. Booking service platforms, such as Airbnb, VRBO, Booking.com, and others, also known as "vacation rentals" or "home-sharing" sites, will not be allowed to process transactions for unregistered short-term rentals. Local Law 18 (LL 18) does not change the existing rules for short-term rentals. Hosts - both owners and tenants - cannot rent out an entire apartment or home to visitors for fewer than 30 days, even if the host owns or lives in the building. This applies to all permanent residential buildings regardless of the number of units. As a host, you must: Stay in the same unit or apartment as the guests Have no more than two guests staying with you Ensure every guest has access to all parts of the dwelling unit and each exit Comply with all other laws relating to the use of the space (i.e., no sleeping in an area where it would be illegal to do so, such as an attic, cellar, or garage) The Short-Term Hosts' Registration application is available. Once registered, you will receive a unique, short-term rental registration number. [Learn more about the Short-Term Rental Registration Law.](https://www.nyc.gov/site/specialenforcement/registration-law/registration.page) [Find tips, informational videos, and FAQ for hosting a legal short-term rental.](https://www.nyc.gov/site/specialenforcement/registration-law/tips-for-hosts.page) Registration [Submit an application via OSE’s Registration Portal.](https://strr-portal.ose.nyc.gov/s/?language=en_US) Short-term rental registration is not allowed for: New York City Housing Authority (NYCHA) apartments Rent-controlled apartments Rent-stabilized apartments Single-Room Occupancy (SRO) units Property owners of buildings where leases or other occupancy agreements prohibit short-term rentals will be able to notify OSE to have their address added to a prohibited buildings list. More Help If you have questions, you can send a message to [registration@ose.nyc.gov](mailto:registration@ose.nyc.gov).
Prohibited Building List
The Short-Term Rental Registration Law also requires OSE to keep a list of buildings where short-term rentals are prohibited, either by: Law (such as NYCHA or entire rent-regulated buildings) or  Leases and occupancy agreements for the building Property owners can notify OSE that short-term rentals are prohibited in their building. [Learn more about, and apply to, the Prohibited Building List.](https://www.nyc.gov/site/specialenforcement/registration-law/pbl.page) Short-term rental registration is not required for: Short-term rental listings for units in “Class B” multiple dwellings Rentals for 30 consecutive days or more [Read more about OSE’s Class B list.](https://www.nyc.gov/site/specialenforcement/reporting-law/class-b-mdl.page)
Check Registration Status
You can check the status of your registration application online. Log in to the Short-Term Rental Registration Portal. Click on “My Short-term Rental Application” to show the status. [Check your registration status.](https://strr-portal.ose.nyc.gov/s/?language=en_US)

title: Fire Safety
body:
Call 911 Call 911   to report a fire or any emergency situation that might cause danger to life or personal property.
Need something else? [Fire Hazard](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/article/?kanumber=KA-01466) to report a potential fire hazard to FDNY [Fire Code](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/article/?kanumber=KA-02727) [Fire Safety Director On-Site Test](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/article/?kanumber=KA-02731) [Fire Safety Inspection](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/article/?kanumber=KA-01471) [Lithium-Ion Battery Safety](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/article/?kanumber=KA-03565) You can get information about fire safety, including: Required fire safety notices in apartment buildings Guidelines for hotels, motels, and office buildings Fire safety education resources and events Carbon monoxide and smoke detector requirements for residential buildings
Fire Safety Notice for Apartment Buildings
Owners of apartment buildings (three or more apartments) are required to post an Emergency Preparedness Notice on the inside of all apartment entrance doors and in the lobby or common area. [Non-combustible fireproof building sample notice](https://www1.nyc.gov/assets/fdny/downloads/pdf/codes/non-combustible-fireproof-building.pdf) [Combustible non-fireproof building sample notice](https://www1.nyc.gov/assets/fdny/downloads/pdf/codes/combustible-non-fireproof-building.pdf) If there is no notice on your apartment door, contact your building owner/manager or notify FDNY at [FDNY.BusinessSupport@fdny.nyc.gov](mailto:FDNY.BusinessSupport@fdny.nyc.gov).
Fire Safety in Office Buildings, Hotels, and Motels
You can get information from the Fire Department about fire safety guidelines for: Office buildings Hotels Motels Property owners, fire safety directors and other management staff are required to file fire safety plans with the City.  The Fire Department provides instructions and forms. Information and assistance is available by phone.
Call [311](tel:311) or 212-NEW-YORK [(212-639-9675)](tel:2126399675) for help.
Fire Safety Education Presentations
The City provides speakers and educational materials on fire safety. Topics include: Burn prevention Common fire hazards Critical evacuation skills Installation and maintenance of smoke detectors Proper use of a fire extinguisher [Request a fire safety presentation.](https://www.fdnysmart.org/safety/)
Fire Prevention Special Events You can get Fire Department resources at high visibility or high occupancy events in New York City through the City.
Call [311](tel:311) or 212-NEW-YORK [(212-639-9675)](tel:2126399675) for help.
Fire Zone Learning Center You can learn about fire safety at the Fire Zone, the City's fire-safety learning center.  Fire safety lessons include learning what to do in an emergency and how to make your own escape plan in case of a fire. Online [Get information about visiting the Fire Zone.](http://www.fdnysmart.org/firezone/) By Phone
Call [311](tel:311) or 212-NEW-YORK [(212-639-9675)](tel:2126399675) for help.
Fire Department Mascots You can request Hotdog and Siren, the Fire Department fire safety and life safety mascots to provide educational entertainment on fire and burn safety at fire safety education events. Information is available about how to request Hotdog and Siren at fire safety education events. [Learn about Hot Dog and Siren, the FDNY mascots.](http://www.fdnysmart.org/hotdog-siren/)
Carbon Monoxide and Smoke Detectors
Carbon Monoxide Detectors Rental and cooperative building owners are required by law to provide and properly install at least one approved carbon monoxide alarm within 15 feet of the primary entrance to each sleeping room. This applies to all one- and two-family homes and residential buildings with three or more units. Carbon monoxide detectors are required to be replaced as their useful life expires. After this replacement, property owners are required to replace carbon monoxide detectors as their useful life expires according to the manufacturer's instructions, based on the original date of installation. The replacement device must be a model that has an end-of-life alarm. While owners are required to install carbon monoxide detectors, tenants are responsible for maintaining them and changing the batteries. Tenants must pay the owner $25 when the owner installs a new carbon monoxide detector, replaces a carbon monoxide detector that has reached the end of its useful life, or replaces one that the tenant lost or damaged. Tenants have up to one year to make the payment. Smoke Detectors Local Law 62 (1981) requires rental and cooperative building owners to install one or more smoke detectors in each unit. It is the tenant's responsibility to maintain them. The City investigates housing complaints and gives tickets to owners who break the law. Smoke detectors should be placed between sleeping areas and the rest of the unit. If there is more than 15 feet between sleeping areas, a smoke detector should be provided for each sleeping area. If there are multiple levels in the unit, smoke detectors should be provided for each level. If mounted on the ceiling, the edge of the smoke detector should be no more than 4 inches from the wall. If mounted on the wall, the edge of the smoke detector should be between 4 and 12 inches from the ceiling. [Learn more about carbon monoxide and smoke detectors.](https://www.nyc.gov/site/hpd/services-and-information/smoke-carbon-monoxide-detectors.page)

title: Delayed Birth Registration
body:
After giving birth in NYC, you must complete and submit the Mother/Parent Worksheet. The NYC Health Department uses this form to register the birth and issue the child’s birth certificate. The NYC Health Department will mail the birth certificate to the parents within 4 weeks of the child’s birth.  In rare cases, births aren’t registered with DOHMH. For example, if the baby was born at home or with a midwife. If you or your child don’t have a birth certificate because the birth was never registered, contact the NYC Health Department. The registration process depends on the child's age. Child Under One If your child was born less than a year ago, call Vital Records.
Call [311](tel:311) or 212-NEW-YORK [(212-639-9675)](tel:2126399675) for help.
Child One or Older If the child was born more than one year ago, you must submit a [Birth Certificate Application](https://www.nyc.gov/assets/doh/downloads/pdf/vr/birth1.pdf). The application will allow Vital Records to check if a birth certificate was ever filed with DOHMH.  If no birth certificate was filed, they will send you a letter letting you know that you must file an Application for Delayed Registration of Birth. You will then have to submit: That letter Completed application At least 3 documents around the time of birth showing convincing evidence that the birth was in NYC Valid photo identification A verbal interview is also required. For an application, email [correctionsunit2@health.nyc.gov](mailto:correctionsunit2@health.nyc.gov) explaining the situation. The Corrections Unit will send the application along with instructions.

title: Childcare Center Abatement
body:
The Childcare Center benefit is a property tax abatement for property owners whose property construction, conversion, alteration, or improvement completed after April 1, 2022, resulted in the creation of a new childcare center or an increase in the maximum number of children allowed in an existing center as specified in the permit issued by the NYC Health Department. Property owners who create a childcare center or increase the number of seats at an existing childcare center may be eligible for a property tax abatement covering up to $225,000 of construction costs. [Learn more about the Childcare Center Abatement.](https://www.nyc.gov/site/finance/benefits/group-childcare-abatement.page)
Level of Benefit
The amount of the abatement depends on whether the seats were created in a childcare desert, a designation that is determined by the New York State Office of Children and Families. Childcare Desert Determinations A childcare desert is a census tract where there are three or more children under five years old for each available childcare slot, or where there are no available childcare slots. If a property is in a childcare desert, owners may be eligible for a property tax abatement of up to $75 per square foot, or up to a total of $225,000. If property is not in a childcare desert, owners may be eligible for a property tax abatement of up to $35 per square foot, or up to a total of $100,000. Abatement Period The abatement is spread over five years, so the maximum abatement amount per year for properties in a childcare desert is up to $15 per square foot, or up to a total of $45,000, and the maximum amount per year for other properties is up to $7 per square foot, or up to a total of $20,000. The City has budgeted a total of $25 million for this property tax abatement. Benefits may be reduced if approved abatements for eligible buildings exceed $25 million.
Deadlines
For exemption benefits to begin on July 1 of the year you apply, your application, and supporting documentation, must be postmarked or submitted on or before March 15. If the due date falls on a weekend or a national holiday, the deadline will be the next business day. Applications that are received after the filing deadline will be processed for July of the following year. 2026/2027 Tax Year The deadline to apply for the 2026/2027 tax year is March 16, 2026. If you’re eligible for the abatement and your 2026/2027 application was postmarked or submitted on or before the deadline, you’ll start receiving benefits on July 1, 2026. If you’re eligible for an exemption and your 2026/2027 application was postmarked or submitted after the deadline, you’ll start receiving benefits on July 1, 2027. 2025/2026 Tax Year The deadline to apply for the 2025/2026 tax year was March 17, 2025. If you’re eligible for the abatement and your 2025/2026 application was postmarked or submitted on or before the deadline, you’ll start receiving benefits on July 1, 2025. If you’re eligible for an exemption and your 2025/2026 application was postmarked or submitted after the deadline, you’ll start receiving benefits on July 1, 2026.
Apply
To apply, you must complete an application and provide all required documents. Mail your application and documents to: NYC Department of Finance Commercial Exemptions and Abatements 59 Maiden Lane, 22nd Floor New York, NY 10038 Once your abatement application is received by the Department of finance (DOF), they will send you an acknowledgment letter.  They will review it and send you a decision letter or a letter requesting additional information within 90 days. Online [Download the Childcare Center Abatement application.](https://www.nyc.gov/assets/finance/downloads/pdf/payment_operations/2023/group-childcare-abatement-app.pdf) In Person You can apply at a DOF Business Center. [Get DOF Business Center locations.](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/article/?kanumber=KA-01015)
Required Documents
Property owners must provide a completed Childcare Center Abatement Application and a childcare provider permit issued by the NYC Health Department. Property owners must also submit determinations that have been certified by a licensed engineer, architect, CPA or other licensed professional regarding the size of the premises, and costs incurred for construction, conversion, or alteration to create new childcare seats in a childcare center that is compliant with the NYC Health Code.

title: Automated Employment Decision Tools
body:
Need something else? [Discrimination](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/article/?kanumber=KA-01783) to report unfair treatment involving an AEDT An automated employment decision tool (AEDT) is a computer-based tool. It is used to screen job candidates or assess employees. An AEDT helps with employment decisions by using: Machine learning Statistical modeling Data analytics Artificial intelligence Under NYC law, to use an AEDT, employers or employment agencies must: Make sure a bias audit was done before using it Post a summary of the results of the bias audit on their website Notify job candidates and employees that an AEDT will be used to assess them Give instructions to request a reasonable accommodation Post a notice about the type and source of the data used for the tool and data retention policy on their website [Learn more about AEDTs.](https://www.nyc.gov/site/dca/about/automated-employment-decision-tools.page) File a Complaint You can report an employer or employment agency that used an AEDT but did not: Make sure the required bias audit was done Post a summary of the results of the bias audit  Give required notices Your complaint must include: Date of suspected violation Explanation of suspected violation Details of the job posting or position Name and type of the AEDT, if known Notice provided, if any

title: Stillbirth or Miscarriage Certificate
body:
A stillbirth or miscarriage is the death of a fetus before or during birth. After a stillbirth or miscarriage, a medical facility or funeral director will register the death of the fetus with the NYC Health Department. There are two types of stillbirth or miscarriage certificates. The type depends how long the fetus developed in the womb (gestation). A certificate of spontaneous termination of pregnancy (miscarriage) certifies the fetal death occurring before or during the 20th week of gestation. A certificate of still birth certifies a fetal death occurring after the 20th week of gestation. Note: If your child was born with some evidence of life, such as a heartbeat or voluntary muscle movement, the infant will have both a birth certificate and death certificate. You must apply separately for these certificates. [Learn more about stillbirth or miscarriage certificates.](https://www.nyc.gov/site/doh/services/birth-death-records-death.page#types) Who Can Order Anyone can request a certificate of spontaneous termination of pregnancy. You can only request a certificate of still birth and miscarriage if you are a parent named on the certificate. If both parents are deceased at the time of stillbirth, you can order if you are an aunt, uncle, or grandparent of the birth parent.
Order a Copy
You can request a copy by mailing an application to the NYC Health Department. If the death took place within the past 12 months, you can also submit the application through the funeral director who served you. All certificates cost $15 and will be mailed. Allow up to six weeks to receive your certificate from the date you send your request. Get an Application You can get the Certificate of Still Birth or Spontaneous Termination of Pregnancy Application. Online [Download the application.](https://www.nyc.gov/assets/doh/downloads/pdf/vr/vr-app-for-stop.pdf) By Mail You can request a paper copy of the application.
Call [311](tel:311) or 212-NEW-YORK [(212-639-9675)](tel:2126399675) to request a copy.
Correct a Certificate
[Learn how to correct a certificate of miscarriage or still birth.](https://www.nyc.gov/site/doh/services/birth-death-records-corrections-death.page#misc)
Get Help
You can contact the Office of Vital Records for help with ordering a still birth or miscarriage certificate. By Email Email [nycdohvr@health.nyc.gov](mailto:nycdohvr@health.nyc.gov). Online [Chat online with an operator](https://dohchat.dirad.com/chat/) Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:30 PM. By Phone
Call [311](tel:311) or 212-NEW-YORK [(212-639-9675)](tel:2126399675) for help.

title: SNAP Nutrition Incentives
body:
Need something else? [SNAP](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/article/?kanumber=KA-01018) to learn how to apply for SNAP benefits SNAP (food stamps) recipients can receive healthy foods through various nutrition programs.
Get the Good Stuff Program
Get the Good Stuff is a program at certain NYC supermarkets. For every $1 you spend using SNAP on eligible fruits, vegetables, and beans, you can get $1 on a Get the Good Stuff card to pay for your next purchase of eligible foods. The Get the Good Stuff program is currently on pause at select locations and is expected to resume at all stores later this Spring. Stores will rejoin the program on a rolling basis.  To check the current status of a store or to see if the store is participating in this program, please check the [Get the Good Stuff](https://www.nyc.gov/site/doh/health/health-topics/free-produce-snap.page) page. This list is updated weekly. Participants can earn up to $10 on their Get the Good Stuff card per day. Eligible foods include: Fresh fruits, vegetables, and herbs Frozen fruits, vegetables, and beans without added sugar, salt, or fat Canned and jarred fruits, vegetables, beans, and lentils without added sugar, salt, or fat Dried beans, lentils, fruits and vegetables without added sugar, salt, or fat ​[Learn more about the Get the Good Stuff program.](https://www.nyc.gov/site/doh/health/health-topics/free-produce-snap.page) Visit a customer service desk at participating supermarkets to sign up.
[Find a participating supermarket.](https://a816-health.nyc.gov/NYCHealthMap/ServiceCategory)
Health Bucks Coupons
Health Bucks are $2 coupons you can use to buy fresh [fruits and vegetables](https://a816-healthpsi.nyc.gov/NYCHealthMap) at all NYC farmers markets and farm stands. SNAP Recipients If you receive SNAP, you can get Health Bucks at NYC farmers markets and farm stands. For every $2 you spend at farmers markets using SNAP benefits on an EBT card, you get $2 in Health Bucks. You can get up to $10 per day. Health Bucks are available year-round at NYC farmers markets that accept EBT. [Learn more about Health Bucks and find a farmers market near you.](https://www.nyc.gov/site/doh/health/health-topics/health-bucks.page) Community and Faith-Based Organizations Not-for-profit organizations can receive free Health Bucks to distribute to community members as an incentive to participate in nutrition education and other health-related activities. The 2025 application for Health Bucks is now closed. The 2026 application will be availability in Spring 2026. Note: Free Health Bucks are limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis. For questions, or if an organization would like to purchase Health Bucks coupons, email [farmersmarkets@health.nyc.gov](mailto:farmersmarkets@health.nyc.gov) for more information.

title: Death Certificate Change
body:
You can correct a death certificate for someone who died in New York City from 1951 to present.  Who Can Correct a Record You may correct a death certificate if you are 18 years or older and the deceased person’s: Spouse or domestic partner Parent Child Sibling Informant listed on the certificate Entitled party If you aren’t listed on the death certificate as the informant, Vital Records will notify the informant of your correction request. Ways to Request a Correction If the facility or provider listed on the certificate made the error and it’s within 12 months of the death, contact them. They can submit the correction request electronically. For all other corrections, you can request a correction by mail or in person. [Appointments are required](https://wb-nycdohmh.qmatic.cloud/qmaticwebbooking/#/) for in-person orders. You can't request a correction online.
Request by Mail
You can request a death certificate correction by mail. You must send: Completed [Death Certificate Correction Application](https://www.nyc.gov/site/doh/services/birth-death-records-corrections-death.page) Photocopy of a current, signed photo ID Required documents Check or money order for fee payment (if applicable) Required Documents The documents you need depend on the correction you want to make. For some corrections, you must include both originals and copies. For a full list of required documents, read the [Death Certificate Correction Application](https://www.nyc.gov/assets/doh/downloads/pdf/vr/dcorrect.pdf).
Application You can get the Death Certificate Correction Application in multiple languages. Online [Get the application.](https://www.nyc.gov/site/doh/services/birth-death-records-corrections-death.page) By Mail
Call [311](tel:311) or 212-NEW-YORK [(212-639-9675)](tel:2126399675) to request a copy.
Cost There is a nonrefundable $40 processing fee per order for most types of corrections. The fee is the same even if you are correcting more than one type of information. If you also want a copy of your corrected certificate sent to you, you must submit a payment of $55. It costs $15 for each copy you request. Cash is not accepted. You must pay by check or money order payable in U.S. dollars to the NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene. Mailing Address Mail the application and required documents to: NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene Corrections Unit Attention: Death Certificate Correction 125 Worth Street, Room 144, CN-4 New York, NY 10013 Processing and Shipping It takes 12 weeks to process the application. Delivery can take an additional 2 weeks.  Processing time does not start until Vital Records receives your application. Allow additional time for your application to be delivered. The Office of Vital Records isn’t liable for items delayed or lost in the mail.
Request in Person
You can request a death certificate correction in person. An appointment is required. [Schedule an appointment.](https://wb-nycdohmh.qmatic.cloud/qmaticwebbooking/#/) What to Bring Completed [Death Certificate Correction Application](https://www.nyc.gov/site/doh/services/birth-death-records-corrections-death.page) Current, signed photo ID Required documents Credit or debit card, check, or money order for payment (if applicable) Required Documents The documents you need depend on the correction you want to make. For some corrections, you must include both originals and copies. For a full list of required documents, read the [Death Certificate Correction Application](https://www.nyc.gov/assets/doh/downloads/pdf/vr/dcorrect.pdf). Cost There is a nonrefundable $40 processing fee per order for most types of corrections. The fee is the same even if you are correcting more than one type of information. If you also want a copy of your corrected certificate sent to you, you must submit a payment of $55. It costs $15 for each copy you request. Cash is not accepted. You can pay by: Credit or debit card Check or money order payable in U.S. dollars in the exact amount to the NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene Location and Hours The Corrections Unit is open from Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 3:30 PM.  Visit: 125 Worth Street, Room 144 (use the 45 Lafayette Street entrance) New York, NY 10013 Processing and Shipping It takes 12 weeks to process the application. Delivery can take an additional 2 weeks. The Office of Vital Records isn’t liable for items delayed or lost in the mail.
Application You can get the Death Certificate Correction Application in multiple languages. Online [Get the application.](https://www.nyc.gov/site/doh/services/birth-death-records-corrections-death.page) By Mail
Call [311](tel:311) or 212-NEW-YORK [(212-639-9675)](tel:2126399675) to request a copy.
Request Status
It takes 12 weeks to process a correction. Delivery by mail may take an additional 2 weeks. You can check the status of a death certificate correction online. [Check order status.](https://a816-evital.nyc.gov/eVitalVRRTS/) If the relevant processing time has passed and you haven’t received your request, you can contact Vital Records. By Email Email [correctionsunit2@health.nyc.gov](mailto:correctionsunit2@health.nyc.gov). By Phone
Call [311](tel:311) or 212-NEW-YORK [(212-639-9675)](tel:2126399675) for status.
Get Help
You can contact the Office of Vital Records for help with: Ordering a certificate Status of an order if processing time has passed Scheduling or canceling an appointment Refunds By Email Email [correctionsunit2@health.nyc.gov](mailto:correctionsunit2@health.nyc.gov). Include: The reason for the email How you ordered (mail or in person) Date you ordered Online [Chat online with an operator](https://dohchat.dirad.com/chat/) Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:30 PM. In Person Appointments are required. [Schedule an appointment.](https://wb-nycdohmh.qmatic.cloud/qmaticwebbooking/#/) Visit: Office of Vital Records 125 Worth Street (use the 45 Lafayette Street entrance) New York, NY 10013 By Phone
Call [311](tel:311) or 212-NEW-YORK [(212-639-9675)](tel:2126399675) for help.
Emergency Record Requests You can get help if you are unable to schedule an appointment and have an emergency request. The request must be related to travel, health care coverage, government services, military, housing, or employment. If you do not have a documented emergency, you must make your request in person (by appointment) or by mail following the normal process. Send an email to [correctionsunit2@health.nyc.gov](mailto:correctionsunit2@health.nyc.gov). Include a clear copy of your unexpired ID and documents showing you have an emergency. Examples include a paid plane ticket, a letter from an employer with a job start date, or a letter from a government agency with an appointment date. If you don't have internet access or are having difficulty sending your documents by email, you can get help by phone.
Call [311](tel:311) or 212-NEW-YORK [(212-639-9675)](tel:2126399675) for help.

title: Lithium-Ion Battery Safety and Complaint
body:
Call 911 Call 911 to report a fire or any emergency situation that might cause danger to life or personal property.  This includes reports of lithium-ion batteries that are:   •  Emitting an odor or odd noises   •  Changing in shape or color   •  Leaking If you notice any of these conditions, stop using the battery immediately . If safe to do so, move the battery away from anything flammable before calling 911 .
Need something else? Learn more about: [Battery Recycling](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/article/?kanumber=KA-02078) [Battery charging](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/article/?kanumber=KA-03627) and[trade-in](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/article/?kanumber=KA-03661) for delivery workers Report: [Electric Bike, Scooter, or Storage Battery Sale Complaint](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/article/?kanumber=KA-03599) Lithium-ion batteries are rechargeable batteries. They are found in electric bikes and scooters, cars, laptops, tablets, phones, and common household devices. Lithium-ion battery fires have caused deaths, serious injuries and devastating damage to property around the city. It is not illegal to own something that uses lithium-ion batteries. However, you must follow all safety guidelines for storing, charging, and disposing these batteries. Never put lithium-ion batteries in your trash or recycling. Do not attempt to build, tamper with, or repair lithium-ion batteries. Only purchase them from verified sources and use certified repair shops if needed.  [Learn more about lithium-ion battery safety.](https://www.fdnysmart.org/be-fdnysmart-when-using-any-devices-powered-by-lithium-ion-batteries/)
Improper Storage, Charging or Disposal Complaints
You can report improper storage, charging, or disposal of lithium-ion batteries or devices containing these batteries.  Complaint types include: Batteries being charged less than 3 feet apart     More than 5 batteries being charged at once Using multiple extension cords to charge batteries Batteries that look like they’ve been tampered with Suspected unlicensed business charging batteries Batteries being disposed in trash or recycling E-bikes or e-scooters being charged while unattended  Abandoned e-bikes on private or public property Any other improper battery storage, charging, or disposal issues You can report the problem to FDNY by email and by phone. Anonymous reports are accepted. By Email [FDNY.BusinessSupport@fdny.nyc.gov](mailto:FDNY.BusinessSupport@fdny.nyc.gov) By Phone
Call [311](tel:311) or 212-NEW-YORK [(212-639-9675)](tel:2126399675) to report the problem.
What Happens Next Your report will be referred to the appropriate Fire Prevention Unit. FDNY will review the report and possibly inspect the location by the next business day.  You will get a response within 12 hours of submitting your report.
Counterfeit Battery Charger Complaints
You can report suspected counterfeit chargers to FDNY. This includes chargers that have fake Underwriters Laboratories (UL) stickers.
Call [311](tel:311) or 212-NEW-YORK [(212-639-9675)](tel:2126399675) for help.
Safety Guidelines
Always purchase and use devices certified by a nationally recognized testing laboratory (NRTL), such as: Underwriters Laboratories, Inc. (UL) Intertek Testing Services NA, Inc. (ITSNA) NSF International (NSF) CSA Group Testing and Certification Inc. You must follow the manufacturer’s instructions for battery storage, charging, and disposal. Storage Guidelines Keep your batteries at room temperature away from direct sunlight. Do not store near a heat source or anything flammable. Do not store your battery in a confined space. Charging Guidelines Always use the correct battery, cord, and power adapter. Plug your device charger directly into a wall outlet.  Charge your battery/device outside, if possible. Keep out of direct sunlight. Monitor your battery for any: Odors Changes in shape or color Leaking Odd noises Do not use generic batteries or chargers unless they are approved for your product. Do not charge your battery/device near a heat source or anything flammable. Do not charge your device on any surface other than the floor. Do not overload an outlet or use an extension cord. Do not overcharge or leave a battery/device charging overnight or unattended. Do not charge your device in a bedroom or near entrances/exits, including: Apartment doors Bedrooms doors Windows Fire escapes Disposal Guidelines It is illegal and dangerous to put lithium-ion batteries in your trash or recycling.  You can dispose of these types of batteries at: [Special waste disposal sites](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/article/?kanumber=KA-01973) Any store that sells rechargeable batteries or products containing them [Learn about battery disposal rules from the Department of Sanitation.](https://www.nyc.gov/site/dsny/collection/get-rid-of/batteries.page)

title: Health Department Violation Correction
body:
Certain violations issued to a business by the NYC Health Department can be “cured." Curing a violation means that if you correct the violation within the required timeframe, then you don’t have to pay a fine. To cure a violation, a business must: Be a food establishment, mobile food vendor, child care center, or pet shop Not have previously received the specific violation Correct the condition for which they received a violation and submit proof for review and approval If the NYC Health Department decides the business has corrected the condition and met all requirements, the violation will be cured and no fines will be given. Only certain violations are curable. [Learn more about curing or paying an NYC Health Department violation.](https://www.nyc.gov/site/doh/business/violations.page)
